name: inappropriate
description: A sense that someone's actions are not aligned with proper behavior in a particular social context.
perceptions: A person has said or done something that breaks a minor social rule.
It might be acceptable in other situations, but not this one.
examples: Gossiping about someone else's deeply personal topics.

guidance.description: Here some guides for handling inappropriate behavior.

commentaries.quote: You've got to change incentives for good behavior as opposed to just disincentivizing bad behavior.
Knowledge is no guarantee of good behavior, but ignorance is a virtual guarantee of bad behavior.
When you don't respond to bad behavior, you get more of it.
